messages:
Riley Park: Hi folks, first week question: where do I post different onboarding issues? VPN, laptop imaging, infra access, that kind of thing. Also there are a few fun bots in other channels— any rules for interacting with them?
Ivy Nguyen: welcome Riley! Short guide: laptop/HR logistics -> #people-ops (see pinned request form), VPN/infra access -> #eng-infra, dev creds or service access -> open a ticket via the SSO onboarding link in #help and cc your manager.
Drew Morales: For anything blocking you from doing work right away (VPN down, no shell), post in #help and mention @eng-oncall or whichever oncall is pinned. People watch that channel during work hours.
Riley Park: good to know. Are bots ok to try out? I saw a "fun-reactions" bot in #random.
Ivy Nguyen: if it's labeled "experiments" or has the sandbox emoji in the description, it's fine. Otherwise, treat them like unknown apps. Don't run slash commands from unfamiliar bots in public channels.
IT Bot: Hello Riley! For hardware swaps, open a ticket at https://peopleops.internal/tickets (link in #people-ops) and include your manager name and shipping address to speed processing.
Drew Morales: We also have #devex-sandbox for trying out integrations and slash commands. If you want to test deploy or CI commands, use that channel or DM the bot.
Riley Park: makes sense. Any short posting etiquette I should follow?
Ivy Nguyen: quick checklist: 1) Search first (Slack + handbook). 2) Pick the most specific channel, not #general. 3) Use threads for followups. 4) Keep code/log snippets minimal and add steps to reproduce. 5) Don9t paste secrets; use the secrets form or DM.
Drew Morales: Example post for a build error: "@eng my build fails on macos-latest, here's the error, I ran `make build` and `./scripts/test`—short log below" with a fenced code block for the 5-8 relevant lines.
Ivy Nguyen: If you accidentally leak a credential, delete the message, rotate the secret immediately and notify #eng-security. There's a pinned incident playbook in that channel.
Riley Park: Thanks! One more bot question: can bots DM me? I9m worried about spam.
Onboarding Bot: Hi Riley! I will DM you only when you trigger onboarding commands or when your manager enrolls you. To re-run your checklist type `/onboard restart` in any channel.
Drew Morales: FYI some integrations (pager, deploy) will post alerts to specific channels and those are read-only for most folks. If in doubt, check channel purpose in the header or ask a channel admin.
Riley Park: Awesome, this clarifies a lot. I9ll use #help and #devex-sandbox for bot stuff. Thanks all :raised_hands:
